Ringing is 21 mV against a 10 mV limit. The sensitivities point to Bf (the output-stage current multiplier) as the main lever: +10 % Bf gives about −7 % ripple. A larger Bf speeds up slewing at the pass gate. My estimate is that the quiescent-current headroom (164 µA against the 200 µA limit) allows Bf ≈ 7–8, adding about 12–24 µA. The topology and other specs pass with margin, so I'm choosing a refine rather than an edit.

{"action": "refine",
 "reason": "Ringing (21 mV) is the only failure; Bf is the dominant lever (-7%/+10%). Iq headroom allows Bf~7-8. Raise Bf, widen its bound, and let ugf/zk/pmr co-tune; the topology itself is sound.",
 "params": {"Bf": 7.0, "ugf": 300e3, "pmr": 2.5, "zk": 1.0, "nI1": 6.0},
 "bounds": {"Bf": [4.0, 9.0], "nI1": [4.0, 8.0], "Idiv": [80e-6, 130e-6]}}
